Scope: infrastructure over about 6.5 km² of the Fourth Industrial City in Riyadh: roads and tunnels, electrical, telecom, ICT and security networks, potable water and fire-fighting, irrigation, sewage and stormwater networks, and sewage and stormwater pumping stations.

Status at a glance

Progress is measured as physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. At 28.5% against 31.5% planned, the project is behind by 3.0% (SPI 0.90). It gained 1.1% this week against 0.7% planned, so the gap narrowed from 3.5% last week. Most of this week's gain again came from procurement (1,871 of 2,678 earned man-hours), while Zones 5, 6 and 8 reported negative earned man-hours. Earthworks remain far ahead of plan, but procurement, the zone network works and the tunnels are still behind.

The schedule still finishes the project about eight months late. The P6 update uploaded this week (data date 09-Nov-2026) finishes the project on 17-Jan-2029, 232 days after the contract completion date of 30-May-2028 (last week: 25-Jan-2029, −240 days). The weekly report gives the same date. In P6 the roads finish on 21-Apr-2027 and the MV network on 04-Nov-2027, against the contract milestone of 30-Sep-2026 for MV and road works.

Delay reasons stated in the report: the master layout changed after the Wadi Al-Sulai redesign, which changed the design of all networks; and equipment was short at the start of the project.

Data notes

This report uses the files uploaded for 09-Nov-2026 (weekly report, progress presentation, quantities and procurement file, P6 update, MASTER LOG) and, for this-week values, the 02-Nov-2026 report. Every progress percentage is physical % complete, weighted by budgeted man-hours. There is no S-curve section: the workbook's Physical-Chart Data sheet is empty.

  • The week number, 49, is the contract week stated on the Milestones sheet ("Current Contract Weeks: 49 of 130"); it also equals the whole weeks from site handover (30-Nov-2025) to the data date.
  • The workbook and the presentation also give a cost-based progress figure, labelled as actual progress in places. This report does not use it.
  • The forecast finish agrees between the P6 update, the P6 extract on the Progress sheet and the General Information sheet (17-Jan-2029, −232 days), but the upper table of the Progress sheet still carries last week's values (25-Jan-2029, −240 days). The Milestones sheet still shows no delay on any milestone.
  • Mobilisation finished on 29-Dec-2025 according to P6 and the presentation, but on 30-Mar-2026 according to the weekly report.
  • Zones 5, 6 and 8 report negative earned man-hours this week (−55.7, −10.7 and −89.2), so their cumulative physical progress went down. The contractor should explain these corrections.
  • Earthworks man-hours have not changed for two weeks (74.0%), although cut rose by 10,000 m³ in each of those weeks.
  • Fill did not change this week (3,457,315 m³). The quantities file and the Conclusion sheet also carry a second "fill" line (3,947,936 m³ total, 120,000 m³ done) whose done quantity equals the subgrade.
  • Tunnel 01 concrete is 5,395 m³ on the Major Quantities sheet but 4,055 m³ on the Major sheet. Box culvert concrete and Tunnel 01 wall concrete both rose by exactly 152 m³ this week; check that the same pour is not counted twice.
  • Quality: the Quality-Stat sheet did not change this week, and its inspection requests still show 490 issued but 1,687 closed and 236 pending. The MASTER LOG (refreshed 11-Nov-2026) gives 69 NCRs (54 closed, 15 open) against 63 (50 closed, 13 open), 1,982 shop drawings against 1,453, 102 MIRs against 113, 107 material submittals against 118, and 2,233 field inspection requests.
  • Safety: man-hours this week are 17,880, the same as last week, and the cumulative inductions (74) and year-to-date man-hours still suggest the HSE counters were reset.
  • Invoices: the workbook lists 9 invoices, 86,818,263 SAR gross, none approved by the MODON PM and none paid; the presentation's financial chart still shows 70,621,360 SAR as paid. Invoice 9 is logged as submitted on 10-Nov-2026, after the data date, with a consultant approval date of 20-Nov-2026, which has not yet arrived. The contract value of 445,000,000 SAR is called "including VAT" on the Conclusion sheet but "excluding VAT" in the bill breakdown.
  • This week's P6 update gives total float for the first time. Milestone floats are measured to the 30-May-2028 must-finish date, so they are positive for milestones that are months behind their contract dates.
  • Activity counts differ: the Weekly Progress Report sheet gives 9,903 activities (2,362 completed, 911 in progress, 6,630 not started), the P6 update 8,625 (1,632, 573 and 6,420).
  • Street lighting is still 180 m, although the presentation and a photo show street-lighting work starting on RD-A-1 this week.
  • Several summary panels still show #REF! or #DIV/0! errors.
  • Photos: all six are GPS-stamped 09-Nov-2026. Not used: the street-lighting photo (portrait, no stamp) and a photo dated 11-Nov-2026, after the data date.
